newsTrading.note: News trading is allowed in Challenge and funded accounts. On funded Stellar 1-Step, 2-Step and Lite accounts (and on Stellar Instant), only 40% of the profit from trades executed 5 minutes before to 5 minutes after a listed high-impact news event on a correlated symbol is counted; losses stay in full. Challenge accounts are not subject to the rule. Source pages dated 2026-09-08 (10701447) and 2026-02-24 (11641410), read 2026-10-22.

evidence.quote: FundedNext allows traders to trade during news events in both the Challenge Phase and the FundedNext Account.
Time Window: Trades executed 5 minutes before and 5 minutes after a listed high-impact news event (a total 10-minute window) will be subject to the News Reward Share Rule.
Profit Calculation: 40% of the profit from these profitable trade(s) will be counted toward the trader’s account balance.
The News Reward Share Rule applies only to Stellar 1-Step, Stellar 2-Step, and Stellar Lite FundedNext Accounts.
Challenge Accounts are not subject to this rule.
Only 40% of the profit from trades placed during this window will be counted toward your account’s profit.
